page.layout: One page of text, single column, with no margin notes. Top: page number "(106)" centred. Then running text, a centred heading "SECT. I.", an italic title with its subtitle, and a paragraph beginning with a large initial. Bottom right: catchword "Alphabetum".

main_text.p: Grammaticam Armenam nemo (uno excepto Calano) hactenus compofuit. Extant vero Lexicon Armeno-Latinum, in quarto, & Institutiones Religionis itidem in quarto in Lingua Armena cum Latina translatione, in usum Armenorum{*}& aliorum jussu Cardinalis Ducis Richlieu Parisiis impressæ, quæ magno adjumento esse possunt iis qui linguæ hujus cognitionem desiderant.
main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: Literas habent 32. quarum Nomina, figu-ras, & potestatem ex sequenti Tabella perspicere licet.

page.notes: The Armenian diphthong line is partly doubtful; each reading is marked [?]. The symbol after "Armenorum," is a printed dagger-like mark, transcribed as {*}. A stray mark after "desiderant." is not text and is left out. The heading "SECT. I." is level 1 with caput="1" because the printed number is I. The catchword "Alphabetum" is printed at the lower right.
